reviews_5s: This is perfect. I was looking for something that was easy to use. Sometimes I just want some fresh grated Parmesan cheese on my pasta. Perfect for those small jobs when you don’t feel like getting out your food processor. Do not hesitate to buy this high-quality product. Also reasonably priced & it does the job well. 5*Best value for the moneyGrates cheese like that’s what it was made for!I have a small kitchen with limited storage space and this grater is perfect as it fits nicely in a drawer and uses little space.ordered in black, got in red, but great product and works fantasticGrates just fineMy wife really likes this grater.
reviews_1s: The product that is pictured is not what was delivered. The product I received had no Slicer whatsoever. It was a grater with a skinny long handle (like a comb would have). All in all just a waste of time. Very misleading pictures and description. Does not do the one thing it said it would. Not worth a penny.First time slicing was great. Subsequent uses slicing blade stopped cutting smoothly, shredded cucumber. Handle is awkward for slicing.Product broke after only 2 weeks of use.
